single.rationale: SiteOne is the national leader in a fragmented, recession-sensitive industry facing near-term margin pressure from housing cycle softness and commodity deflation. While the company improved operating margins year-over-year (from 4.3% to 5.1%) and demonstrated pricing power recovery, the 42x P/E and 1.4x EV/revenue multiples appear stretched given 3.6% revenue growth, 9.1% ROE, and continued macroeconomic headwinds in residential/commercial construction. The acquisition strategy and market consolidation opportunity provide medium-term upside, but current valuation limits near-term return potent
